label: AU-3(3)
title: Limit Personally Identifiable Information Elements

statement.prose: Limit personally identifiable information contained in audit records to the following elements identified in the privacy risk assessment: {{ insert: param, au-03.03_odp }}.

guidance: Limiting personally identifiable information in audit records when such information is not needed for operational purposes helps reduce the level of privacy risk created by a system.

params.label: elements
guidelines: elements identified in the privacy risk assessment are defined;
